evidence_summary: UniProt describes lamin A/C homodimers, head-to-tail polymers, and lateral protofilament assembly; LMNA is required for cardiac homeostasis and is central to cardiolaminopathy.
support_sources: UniProt P02545; PubMed 15476822; PubMed 31434876; PubMed 33706103; PubMed 10580070; PubMed 12927431; PubMed 23666920
caveat: AF3 homodimer is a reduced assembly model, not a full nuclear lamina filament or PTM-aware proteoform.

evidence_summary: LMNA and emerin are curated nuclear-envelope partners; EMD is cardiac/skeletal-muscle relevant and full-length LMNA-EMD was weak, so a compact nuclear-facing rescue design is more interpretable.
support_sources: UniProt P02545; UniProt P50402; PubMed 12475961; PubMed 19323649; PubMed 11792822; PubMed 32923640; local AF3_JOB_003_LMNA_EMD result
caveat: Excludes EMD membrane anchor and nuclear-envelope membrane context; use only if pair confidence/contact evidence is strong.

evidence_summary: LMNA IF rod 31-387 is the structured coiled-coil assembly region; dimerization/polymerization is core lamin biology and a plausible variant-context feature.
support_sources: UniProt P02545 domain 31-387; PubMed 15476822; PubMed 31434876; PubMed 33706103
caveat: This is a domain-level assembly proxy; it does not model the complete filament lattice.

evidence_summary: Full-length LMNA 1-664 plus EMD 1-254 was previously submitted and was not interface-usable.
caveat: Do not repeat by default unless we need a sensitivity rerun.

evidence_summary: TMEM43 retains emerin at the inner nuclear membrane and has nuclear-envelope disease relevance, but the prior full-length trimer was not interface-usable.
support_sources: UniProt Q9BTV4; UniProt P50402; UniProt P02545; PubMed 18230648; PubMed 21391237; local AF3_PILOTV1_REVIEW_TMEM43_EMD_LMNA
caveat: Needs membrane/topology-aware design; better handled in TMEM43 or EMD packet.

evidence_summary: These are real nuclear-envelope or lamin-associated candidates, but they need sequence availability, cardiac-context prioritization, and boundary review before AF3 submission.
support_sources: UniProt P02545; UniProt P50402; PubMed 19933576; PubMed 23977161; PubMed 10514485; PubMed 35311970
